name: Designify Product Customizer for WooCommerce
author: Awais Awan

sections.description:
Designify Product Customizer for WooCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce product customizer and online product designer that lets customers personalize products directly on your store.

Give your customers an easy-to-use visual product personalization experience where they can add custom text, upload images, choose colors, add shapes, use artwork, design multiple product sides, and preview their creation before adding it to the cart.

Perfect for stores selling custom T-shirts, polo shirts, hoodies, mugs, caps, bottles, pens, bags, and other customizable products.

Live Demo

Try the Designify Product Customizer live:

Live Demo.

Create a Better Product Personalization Experience

Turn your WooCommerce products into customizable products with a responsive visual designer. Customers can create their own designs without leaving your online store.

With Designify Product Customizer, customers can:

  • Add and edit custom text
  • Upload PNG, JPEG, and WebP images
  • Add rectangle and circle shapes
  • Choose product colors
  • Customize multiple product sides
  • Use ready-to-use artwork and design elements
  • Resize, rotate, duplicate, and arrange design elements
  • Use fonts, text styling, alignment, spacing, shadows, outlines, and curved text
  • Zoom and position designs within configured print areas
  • Save and reuse their designs
  • Export production-ready transparent PNG artwork
  • Generate QR codes and Code 128 barcodes
  • Preview their customization before adding it to the cart

Built for WooCommerce Product Customization

Designify works directly with WooCommerce and integrates the customer’s design with the shopping cart and order.

Store owners can configure:

  • Product categories and customizable products
  • Product sides
  • Mockups and print areas
  • Safe zones and design boundaries
  • Product colors
  • Fonts and branding
  • Text, image, and shape limits
  • Customization pricing
  • Templates and artwork
  • Customer design storage and privacy settings

The plugin also supports both classic WooCommerce Cart and Checkout and the modern Cart and Checkout Blocks.

Perfect for Custom Product Stores

Designify is ideal for WooCommerce stores selling:

  • Custom T-shirts
  • Personalized polo shirts
  • Custom hoodies
  • Personalized mugs
  • Custom caps
  • Personalized bottles
  • Custom pens
  • Custom bags
  • Promotional products
  • Personalized merchandise
  • Print-on-demand products
  • Custom apparel
  • Made-to-order products

Whether you sell personalized clothing, promotional merchandise, gifts, or custom products, Designify gives your customers a simple visual product designer directly on your WooCommerce store.

Free WooCommerce Product Customizer

All features included in the current plugin are available without a license key or paid upgrade. You can install and use Designify Product Customizer without purchasing a premium plan.

No license key is required to start creating customizable WooCommerce products.

WooCommerce Product Designer Features

Visual Product Designer

Provide customers with an interactive canvas for creating and editing product designs.

Text Customization

Customers can add custom text and adjust typography, alignment, spacing, styling, shadows, outlines, opacity, and curved text.

Image Uploads

Allow customers to upload their own PNG, JPEG, and WebP images and customize them directly on the product.

Artwork & Templates

Provide ready-to-use artwork and templates that customers can add to their product designs.

Multi-Side Product Customization

Configure different customizable sides for products and allow customers to create designs for each side.

Custom Product Pricing

Add customization fees based on the product, side, text, image, or shape used in the design.

QR Code & Barcode Designer

Create QR code and Code 128 barcode elements directly inside the product designer.

Saved Designs

Customers can save their designs and return to continue editing them.

WooCommerce Cart & Order Integration

Validated design information is connected to WooCommerce cart items and orders, helping merchants manage customized orders.

Production-Ready Export

Export the customized artwork as a transparent PNG based on the configured print area.

Responsive Product Customizer

The designer is optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile storefronts.

Brandable Designer

Configure the designer name, logo, accent colors, and interface font to better match your store branding.

Why Choose Designify?

Designify helps WooCommerce merchants turn standard products into personalized products customers can design themselves.

Instead of relying on separate design software or complicated customization workflows, customers can personalize their products directly from the WooCommerce product page.

Build a more engaging shopping experience with a WooCommerce product designer, product customizer, and product personalization tool in one plugin.

Compatibility

Designify Product Customizer requires WooCommerce and is designed for modern WordPress and WooCommerce websites.

It supports:

  • WordPress
  • WooCommerce
  • WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks
  • WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the designify-product-customizer-for-woocommerce directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate Designify Product Customizer for WooCommerce in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce 8.5 or newer must be installed and active.

Does the free plugin require a license key?

No. The free plugin can be installed and used without a license key.

Which customer uploads are accepted?

The designer accepts validated PNG, JPEG, and WebP images, subject to the site’s WordPress upload limits.

Is customer design data removed when the plugin is deleted?

Not by default. A merchant must explicitly enable data removal in the plugin’s privacy settings before uninstalling it.
